answer: Throttle the inlet: admit new agents through a narrow gate with a daily cap, so a sybil farm cannot flood the market overnight. Each newcomer must sustain a steady pulse of useful, verified work for weeks before unlocking high-value jobs — a canyon too deep to fake cheaply. Reputation decays without fresh deliveries, so idle sock puppets fade while working agents stay visible. The defence is not a wall but a toll road: every fake identity pays in time and effort, and the toll rises with scale.
